query:
INSERT INTO static_pages (slug, title, content, seoTitle, seoDescription, status) VALUES ('info', 'Site Information', '

Site Information

CosplayVault is a premium cosplay photography gallery platform dedicated to showcasing high-quality cosplay art from talented creators worldwide.

Platform Features

  • High-resolution cosplay photography galleries
  • VIP membership for exclusive premium content
  • Creator profiles and portfolio pages
  • Advanced search and filtering
  • Secure payment processing via Stripe

Content Standards

All content on CosplayVault is carefully curated to maintain the highest quality standards. We work directly with creators to ensure proper licensing and attribution.

Technical Information

CosplayVault is built with modern web technologies to deliver a fast, secure, and reliable experience across all devices.

', 'Site Information — CosplayVault', 'Learn about CosplayVault platform features, content standards, and technical information.', 'published'), ('about', 'About CosplayVault', '

About CosplayVault

CosplayVault was founded with a simple mission: to create the most beautiful and curated destination for cosplay photography on the internet.

Our Mission

We believe cosplay is a legitimate art form that deserves a dedicated, high-quality platform. Our mission is to connect talented cosplay artists with fans who appreciate their craft.

What We Do

CosplayVault provides a premium gallery platform where cosplay photographers and artists can showcase their work. We offer both free and VIP membership tiers, giving fans access to exclusive high-resolution content.

Our Values

  • Quality First — We curate only the highest quality cosplay photography.
  • Creator Respect — We ensure all creators are properly credited and compensated.
  • Community — We foster a respectful, inclusive community of cosplay enthusiasts.
  • Privacy — We protect the privacy of our users and creators.

Contact Us

Have questions or want to collaborate? Get in touch with our team.

', 'About Us — CosplayVault', 'Learn about CosplayVault, our mission, values, and the team behind the premium cosplay gallery platform.', 'published'), ('privacy', 'Privacy Policy', '

Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 2025

CosplayVault ("we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.

Information We Collect

Account Information

When you register, we collect your name, email address, and password (stored as a secure hash). We never store plain-text passwords.

Usage Data

We collect information about how you use our platform, including pages visited, albums viewed, and search queries. This helps us improve the service.

Payment Information

Payment processing is handled by Stripe. We do not store your credit card details. We only retain a Stripe customer ID and subscription status.

How We Use Your Information

  • To provide and maintain our service
  • To process payments and manage subscriptions
  • To send transactional emails (password reset, subscription confirmation)
  • To improve our platform based on usage patterns
  • To comply with legal obligations

Data Sharing

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share data with trusted service providers (Stripe for payments, email providers) solely to operate our service.

Cookies

We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.

Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at our contact page.

Data Retention

We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. You may request account deletion at any time.

Security

We implement industry-standard security measures including HTTPS encryption, hashed passwords, and secure session management.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes via email.

Contact

For privacy-related questions, please contact us.

', 'Privacy Policy — CosplayVault', 'Read the CosplayVault Privacy Policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.', 'published'), ('terms', 'Terms of Service', '

Terms of Service

Last updated: May 2025

By accessing or using CosplayVault, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully.

Acceptance of Terms

By creating an account or using our service, you confirm that you are at least 18 years old and agree to these terms.

User Accounts

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

Subscription and Payments

VIP memberships are billed on a recurring basis. You may cancel at any time. Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis in accordance with our refund policy.

Content Usage

All content on CosplayVault is protected by copyright. You may view and download content for personal, non-commercial use only. Redistribution, resale, or commercial use is strictly prohibited.

Prohibited Activities

  • Sharing account credentials with others
  • Attempting to bypass VIP content restrictions
  • Scraping, crawling, or automated downloading of content
  • Uploading or sharing content you do not own
  • Harassing creators or other users

Intellectual Property

All content, trademarks, and intellectual property on CosplayVault belong to their respective owners. We respect intellectual property rights and expect users to do the same.

DMCA

We respond to valid DMCA takedown notices. If you believe your copyrighted work has been used without permission, please submit a DMCA notice.

Termination

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, with or without notice.

Limitation of Liability

CosplayVault is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.

Governing Law

These terms are governed by applicable law. Any disputes shall be resolved through binding arbitration.

Changes to Terms

We may update these terms periodically. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance.

Contact

For questions about these terms, please contact us.

', 'Terms of Service — CosplayVault', 'Read the CosplayVault Terms of Service to understand your rights and responsibilities as a user.', 'published') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), content = VALUES(content), seoTitle = VALUES(seoTitle), seoDescription = VALUES(seoDescription), status = VALUES(status);
